summary.text: Judy Boyle is a Republican who represents District 9 (Seat B) in the Idaho House of Representatives and is listed in a ninth term; the directory lists Boyle's occupation as agriculture and writer.

paragraphs.text: According to the legislature's biography, Boyle attended Lassen Community College, Boise State University and the University of Idaho.
It says Boyle is an agriculture and freelance writer and was natural resources director for former U.S. Representative Helen Chenoweth.
